work_packages.title: Secret Hygiene, .gitignore, Pinned Dependencies & Demo Seed Guard
acceptance_criteria: ID-005: AppConfig.validate_production_secrets() raises RuntimeError when ENV=production and secrets are missing or match known placeholders
ID-006: .gitignore exists and excludes .env, *.db, s3_vault/, worktrees/, evidence/, and __pycache__/
ID-020: requirements.txt pins exact == versions for all dependencies
ID-021: src/dashboard/app.py only seeds demo users when cfg.environment == 'development'
